name_input: M/S CHITRA SALES PRIVATE LTD.; CHITRA SALES PRIVATE LIMITED; CHITRA SALES PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs records), page https://importkey.com/countries/india/chitra-sales-private-limited — counter states "Total Shipments 6 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2024-08-20"; rows actually seen: 3 shipment lines (all dated 2024-08-20, BOL 3344274, origin TUGLAKABAD ICD, India → destination Brisbane, AUSTRALIA, HS 42022990, buyer JUANN IMPORTS PTY LTD). Exact line: "2024-08-20 | CHITRA SALES PRIVATE LIMITED | JUANN IMPORTS PTY LTD | CAR SEAT TRAVEL BAG (LARGE) STYLE CODE-JIP-002 PU FABRIC | TUGLAKABAD ICD, India | Brisbane, AUSTRALIA | 42022990 | 3344274". Second line: "TRAVEL STROLLER BAG (SMALL) STYLE CODE-JIP-003 PU FABRIC ... 42022990 | 3344274"; third: "PREMIUM TRAVEL STROLLER BAG STYLE CODE-JIP-001 PU FABRIC ... 42022990 | 3344274". Ports counter: "TUGLAKABAD ICD, INDIA 3 / BRISBANE, AUSTRALIA 3". Slug variant 'chitra-sales-pvt-ltd' returned an empty record set ("Loading...", no rows).
note: Real export shipments are documented: 3 visible customs lines (counter says 6 total) dated 2024-08-20, India (Tuglakabad ICD) → Brisbane, Australia, buyer JUANN IMPORTS PTY LTD, BOL 3344274, HS 42022990 (travel/stroller bags of PU fabric). Declared HS in the batch (420211/420212/420219/420221) does not match the actual shipped code 42022990 — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the factual code is 42022990 (bags, other, outer surface of textile/other materials). Note the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is contradicted by the shipment description (bags/luggage) — likely a data-entry error on the sourcing side. Domestic supply evidence not established: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits could not be checked — recorded as unknown, not as 'none found'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free view: null. No CIN/PAN confirmed (not public in accessible sources).
